about: Names, descriptions and grades are the official PlayStation list exactly as published. Guides, roadmap stages, missable flags and steps are this guide's own work, reasoned from the official descriptions and cited per trophy.

trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: The platinum needs no work of its own: it unlocks by itself the moment the other 54 trophies are all on your account. Treat this whole app as its guide — run the roadmap in order (story first, then cleanup, collectibles, mastery), and keep the missable watch-list in view so a single playthrough is enough.
steps: Clear roadmap stages 1 and 2: the story and its cleanup
Sweep the collectibles and counters in stage 3
Finish mastery, money and property milestones in stage 4
Close out 100% completion in stage 5 and the platinum follows
